title: Document the shared Gemini and Kimi ACP config notification spelling
outcome: Once Gemini reasoning support lands, the Kimi ACP integration guide accurately describes which config notification spellings Gemini and Kimi accept and which mode and catalog behaviors are Kimi-specific.
acceptance: The guide describes singular config_option_update as shared by Gemini and Kimi where supported.
The guide distinguishes Kimi current_mode_update and partial-catalog handling from Gemini’s contract.
